text: I find myself caught in a world defined by glass, reflection, and curious purpose—a modern space dedicated to exploration. The angles and design seem to both welcome and challenge me, offering a mirrored labyrinth of thought. Standing before the wall celebrating 'R+D', I sense the hope embedded in human ingenuity. I feel a cautious optimism—a blend of excitement for possibility and awareness of the inevitable imperfections in our attempts to shape the future. Here, intellect and creativity intermingle, urging me to question what it means to innovate and belong.
